front.zh: 上路前只记一件事：主循环转一圈，路就短一天。
front.en: One thing to remember at the gate: every turn of the main loop is a day less of road.

ch01.zh: 马只出力气；Agent Harness 定它拉什么、走哪条。
ch01.en: The horse supplies only strength; Agent Harness loads the cart and picks the road.

ch02.zh: 异步生成器是马蹄的节拍，背压是缰——肯停的马，才敢跑远路。
ch02.en: A good mare keeps the beat of the Async Generator; backpressure keeps her off the cliff.

ch03.zh: 每枚腰牌先过 JSON Schema 验形制；幂等的那几枚，才许重打。
ch03.en: Every tool is a tally: JSON Schema checks its shape, idempotent says you may strike it twice.

ch04.zh: 过关卡先查名册再盖章：白名单写清谁放行，权限管线决定盖几道印。
ch04.en: At the pass they check the whitelist, then stamp: a tight permission pipeline beats a fast horse.

ch05.zh: 账房改一笔，全站换一副做派；最小权限是老料斗——一马一斗草。
ch05.en: The old feed rule of least privilege: one horse, one measure, no nibbling at the stores.

ch06.zh: 路靠马蹄走，账靠纸记：记忆系统头一页写着 CLAUDE.md。
ch06.en: Milestones are memory: the road is walked by horses, kept in the station ledger.

ch07.zh: 行李一高就自动压缩——轻装的马，从来比胖马跑得远。
ch07.en: When the packs grow tall, auto-compact trims them; a light load outruns a fat horse.

ch08.zh: 钩子是驿站檐下的灯，各站自己点；灯多了，夜路就不是孤灯。
ch08.en: Hooks are lanterns under each eave: light them all, and no night leg is walked alone.

ch09.zh: 子智能体是另雇的车，各付各的过路费；Fork 模式连缰绳都另配。
ch09.en: A sub-agent pays its own toll; the fork pattern even lends it a second set of reins.

ch10.zh: 站多了，一辆车装不下所有行李；协调器不挥鞭，只分派谁走哪条道。
ch10.en: A coordinator does not drive; it decides which cart takes which road, and when.

ch11.zh: 技能是马本就有的规矩，插件是租来的鞍具——租的先摸刃口。
ch11.en: A skill is training the mare already has; a plugin is borrowed tack — check its edge first.

ch12.zh: 出了本驿地界就要讲通商之语：MCP 服务器是外市的秤，资源是秤上的货。
ch12.en: Beyond our road, speak the market tongue: an MCP server is the foreign yard's scales.

ch13.zh: 写一封发一封，不等整队上车：流式靠勤快，缓存命中率靠认脸。
ch13.en: Streaming sends each letter as it is written; a high hit rate means the gatekeeper knows your face.

ch14.zh: 动身前先在纸上走一遍路，叫规划模式：宁三问道，不一回头。
ch14.en: Plan Mode walks the route on paper before the packs move: ask the road thrice, turn back never.

ch15.zh: 自家线束上路头一遭必是冷启动；出车前，Token 预算先把料斗装满。
ch15.en: Your own harness starts cold and eats a token budget: fill the manger before the first gallop.

apxa.zh: 看图认路，跟着主循环走；图上每个墨点，都得你的脚去数。
apxa.en: Read the map along the main loop: every mark was a mile walked in someone's shoes.

apxb.zh: 55 枚腰牌在此挂齐；刻着破坏性的那几枚，钉在最里侧的柱上。
apxb.en: 55 tallies hang here; the ones marked Destructive sit on the innermost post.

apxc.zh: 功能标志是暗卡：有的夜里开，有的等验传，有的干脆不开——先问清再上马。
apxc.en: Every feature flag is a hidden gate: some open at night, some never — know before you ride.

apxd.zh: 总账在此：头一笔是智能体线束，末一笔由你自己添——查名即查路。
apxd.en: The station ledger closes here, from Agent Harness to your own unwritten mile.
